title: Perplexity Computer Now Rebuilds Apps Without Source Code
summary:
The integration of a technical skill created by developer @morluto allows for the automatic reconstruction of software replicas through behavioral analysis. Users of the product known as Computer can now employ this Reverse-Engineer-Anything (REA) capability to analyze the inner logic of an application and generate a functioning duplicate of it.

Perplexity is providing up to 10,000 credits for the /reverse-engineer command free of charge through October 31. To demonstrate the tool's efficacy, the company has released five example applications for a limited trial, including a version of the design platform Figma that supports multiplayer editing and auto-layout.

REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) by @morluto is now a skill in Computer.

Ask Computer to reverse-engineer an app and it inspects how the app works without its source code, then builds a working version.

Tasks that use /reverse-engineer are free through October 31, up to 10,000 credits per user.

Here are 5 apps Computer made with it, available to try for a limited time:

1) Figma: Design with layers and auto-layout, plus sign-in, cross-device sync, and multiplayer editing. Try it: https://t.co/FGGTblkCWY
